rationale: The claim is a specific derivation of the quantum operator formalism from uncertainty and indistinguishability postulates. Although the axiomatic-method meta-principle is methodologically related to derivations, it does not support the particular inference or the physical content of the claim. No supplied candidate addresses the derivation of operator formalism from these postulates, so no defensible grounding link exists.
